title_zh: Social communication — 第25节可背诵讲义
body_en: Social communication starts with listening. Look at the speaker and wait your turn. Use polite phrases: please, thank you, sorry, excuse me. Online messages need care too — never send words you would not say face to face. Clear talk prevents many problems.
body_zh: 社交沟通从倾听开始。看着说话的人，轮到你再开口。使用礼貌用语：请、谢谢、对不起、借过。网上留言也要谨慎——别发你当面不会说的话。清楚表达能避免很多问题。
